story.body: You stood under the dressed lintel and did not leave the close. You were in by six.

participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the twenty-five pounds, set the sixty shillings apart inside that count, and entered eight and twelve with no remark.

participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Said the loaf was smaller than winter's and still a penny.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

story.body: You ate. The loaf was still a penny, and cutting it did not make it larger.

title: Ate the loaf cut four ways

participation.context: Stood the short prayer and went home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept it short, and went back to her door.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

story.body: You stayed for a short evening prayer. The glass was not turned.
